description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technological Service - Amendment No. 3
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technological Service, specifically detailing recruitment methods, qualification requirements, and disciplinary provisions for public service positions. It focuses on public sector service conditions, recruitment procedures, and administrative regulations issued by the Public Service Commission, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) covering public service recruitment, service conditions, and administrative circulars.
